themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries for research and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing specific software or platforms designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and understand code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Content that explores how AI is being used to automate or enhance the process of testing user interfaces and product usability.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Articles detailing the impact of AI on job markets, including AI's role in hiring, job displacement, and skill development for the workforce.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is affecting employment, job roles, and the skills required for the future workforce.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of simulated user profiles or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Content centered on AI's capability to analyze and interpret user emotions, opinions, and feedback from various sources.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the features, performance, and value of different AI tools used for research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
